description: Save an AI memory item. Required: name, content. Scope it with entity ('lead'|'contact'|'account'|'campaign') + entity_id (a CRM record) AND/OR brain_id + agent_id (agent 'brain' memory). category is a free topical label (default 'general'). importance 1-5 (default 3) for ranking. key = stable handle for upsert (update the same fact instead of appending); the key is unique PER SCOPE (entity + entity_id + agent_id + brain_id), so the same key on two different leads keeps two items. The result says which scope was written. source, occurred_at (ISO original date) optional. (Legacy: parent_id = entity_id.) DURABLE RULE from a human for an agent ("ab jetzt immer …"): agent_id = that agent (yourself), category 'regel', importance 5, content = the rule quoted verbatim + ' — <person>, <date>'; it is loaded into every later run (runner and server_job, get_agent_bootstrap agentRules). An agent writing its OWN memory is never parked for approval.

agent_id.description: Owning agent (omit = shared across the user's agents)

brain_id.description: Agent brain (category) this memory belongs to

content.description: Text content of the memory item

key.description: Stable handle → upsert instead of duplicate, within the scope (the same key on another record is another item)

name.description: Name of the AI memory item

occurred_at.description: ISO date the fact originated in its source system.

source.description: Where the fact comes from (optional provenance)

name: create_ai_memory_item
